Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:
what happens if you (in a storyline tournament) control the eye and the edge in the beginning of
your turn?

My scenario:

take 1 pool for edge
burn eye as I don't want to pay
burn edge to get eye

do I here have to pay for the eye to keep it, or have I allready made the choice of not paying (as
the "During your untap phase, burn 1 pool or burn this equipment" uses the "during X do Y" template,
suggests that this only happens once in your untap)

/henrik isaksson

that is, if we get any eye's... =(

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henrik Isaksson wrote:
>
> what happens if you (in a storyline tournament) control the eye and the edge in the beginning of
> your turn?
>
> My scenario:
>
> take 1 pool for edge
> burn eye as I don't want to pay

... and the bearer of the eye takes 5 damage for losing it.

> burn edge to get eye

Sure.

> do I here have to pay for the eye to keep it, or have I allready made the choice of not paying (as
> the "During your untap phase, burn 1 pool or burn this equipment" uses the "during X do Y" template,
> suggests that this only happens once in your untap)

The latter. (Note that this only affects storyline tournaments - the "burned" eye would normally go to someone's ash heap, where it would forget all about the foregone payment).
